title: medica maritima
intro: Medica maritima, commonly known as Irish Moss, is a type of red algae found in the coastal waters of the North Atlantic Ocean. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Irish Moss include its ability to act as an emollient, demulcent, and expectorant, making it useful in treating conditions such as irritable bowel syndrome and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of Irish Moss include carrageenan, fucoidan, and other polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a popular ingredient in traditional remedies and modern supplements.
